qualifier: Hartnup, SLC1A1 and SLC6A14 transporter defects
name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport: Hartnup, SLC1A1, SLC6A14 defects
rationale: All members concern SLC-mediated amino acid uptake across the plasma membrane; the theme uniquely combines Hartnup/tryptophan transport with SLC1A1 and SLC6A14 variants, while confusables carry iminoglycinuria, peptide or cystinuria transporters instead.

core: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor differentiation
qualifier: progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of maturation
name: Myeloid progenitor transcriptional control and restraint of differentiation
rationale: Members describe transcriptional programmes (RUNX1, VENTX, promyelocyte module) governing myeloid progenitors; unlike confusables centred on granulocyte/monocyte maturation, this theme carries progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation.

qualifier: AXIN stability in the destruction complex
name: Canonical Wnt signalling: AXIN stability and destruction complex
rationale: All members are canonical Wnt/beta-catenin events, and the theme is distinguished from other Wnt themes by AXIN degradation and its stabilisation by XAV939 plus destruction-complex defects.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase stimulation
name: Adenylate cyclase-stimulated cAMP synthesis and PKA activation
rationale: Members cover GPCR-driven cAMP production (including forskolin response) and PKA activation; this separates it from the inhibitory adenylate cyclase theme and from confusables built around CREB and calcium-calmodulin cyclases.

core: Vitamin K, C and E metabolism and response
qualifier: vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation with vitamin C metabolism
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation with vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members concern metabolism of and response to vitamins K, C and E, centred on gamma-carboxylation of clotting precursors; the vitamin C arm distinguishes it from vitamin E/ubiquinol and vitamin D confusables, and the vitamin K arm from the oxygen-transport confusable.

core: GPCR regulation of adenylate cyclase activity
qualifier: Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory route
name: Adenylate cyclase regulation by Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: All members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase, dominated by Gi/Gz inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors; unlike confusables it lacks PKA activation, catecholamine secretion control and muscarinic/purinergic receptors.

qualifier: RUNX2, Wnt antagonism and mechanical load
name: Osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors via RUNX2 and Wnt
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation through RUNX2, BMP and Wnt; it lacks the osteoclast, chondrocyte and collagen members of confusables and uniquely has Wnt antagonists and osteocyte mechanosensing.

qualifier: tyrosine catabolism with proline and glycine metabolism
name: Amino acid metabolism: tyrosine catabolism, proline and glycine
rationale: All members are amino acid biosynthesis or catabolism; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from threonine/organic acid confusables, and proline, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism from the phenylalanine/PKU confusable.

qualifier: follicle growth, oocyte maturation and luteal phase
name: Ovarian cycle: follicle growth, oocyte maturation, luteal phase
rationale: Members span ovarian follicle development, ovulation, oocyte maturation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle; confusables instead carry gonadotropin responses and Sertoli cells.

qualifier: linkage-specific ubiquitination, deubiquitinases and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome system: linkage-specific ubiquitination, deubiquitinases, proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin chain synthesis and editing, DUB families and proteasomal degradation; proteasome assembly and DUB families distinguish it from neddylation/COP9 and autophagy/ERAD quality-control confusables.

qualifier: SERCA-mediated reuptake and caffeine-sensitive ryanodine regulation
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ reuptake via SERCA and ryanodine regulation
rationale: Members lower cytosolic calcium by SR/ER sequestration and restrain ryanodine-receptor release; SERCA-type ATPase regulation, SR import and caffeine response distinguish it from confusables focused on calcium release and cardiac contraction.

qualifier: receptor recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport
name: Endocytic receptor recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane traffic
rationale: All members concern vesicle traffic between plasma membrane, endosomes and Golgi; recycling to the surface, Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport and vesicular cholesterol transport separate it from retrograde endosome-to-Golgi and Golgi retention confusables.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly
name: Fibronectin-integrin focal adhesion in fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link integrins, fibronectin matrix, SRF-driven cytoskeleton and focal adhesions to fibroblast migration; focal adhesion assembly and the collagen/TGFB module distinguish it from syndecan/stress-fibre and EMT confusables.

qualifier: VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis and smooth muscle phenotypic switching
name: Angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members regulate endothelial VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; the smooth muscle arm separates it from the endothelial-only confusable and the angiogenesis arm from leukocyte-adhesion and aortic confusables.

qualifier: muscle atrophy and inactivity
name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members restrain myoblast and muscle development and mediate atrophy with inactivity and SCF ubiquitin ligase activity; confusables instead promote myogenesis, regeneration, contraction or hypertrophy.

qualifier: BCR and TCR with CD28 costimulation and coinhibition
name: BCR and TCR signalling with CD28 costimulation and coinhibition
rationale: All members concern antigen receptor signalling in B and T cells and its co-signals (CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22); the BCR arm distinguishes it from T-cell-only confusables.

qualifier: palate and limb
name: Embryonic craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic morphogenesis of face, palate, skull, nose and limbs with mesenchymal development; confusables instead carry ossification or pharyngeal-derived organs (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid).

qualifier: ADP, thrombin and thromboxane receptor signalling
name: Platelet activation via ADP, thrombin and thromboxane receptors
rationale: Members cover platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation; agonist GPCR signalling (P2Y1/12, PARs, TP, prostacyclin receptor) distinguishes it from integrin/Rap1 and GPIb-collagen adhesion confusables.

core: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release in muscle
qualifier: cardiac contraction and heart rate
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release controlling cardiac contraction and rhythm
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium release and clearance (ryanodine, NCX) to control muscle contraction, with cardiac contractility, relaxation and heart rate distinguishing it from SERCA-centred and positive-inotropy confusables.

qualifier: endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion
name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern trafficking of membrane proteins between plasma membrane, endosomes and Golgi; endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion distinguish it from Rab/ARF signalling and Golgi-lysosome/retrograde confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
qualifier: stress granules and translational repression
name: Stress granule mRNA stabilization and translational repression
rationale: Members regulate mRNA stability (HuR, AUF1, IGF2BP), localization and translation under stress (PKR, arsenite, stress granules); confusables emphasise TTP/KSRP/BRF1-driven decay and decapping instead.

qualifier: MITF-M targets and light response
name: MITF-M melanocyte pigmentation and response to light
rationale: Members concern melanocyte proliferation, MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis and UV/blue-light responses; confusables carry MITF-M cell-cycle/DNA-damage programmes or melanosome biogenesis instead.

qualifier: renal amino acid, peptide and urate handling
name: Renal SLC transport of amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC carriers and their epithelial transport disorders for amino acids, oligopeptides, urate and organic anions; this separates it from hexose, cationic amino acid and organic cation transport confusables.

core: Epithelial ion transport and osmotic regulation
qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport and salt stress
name: Cation-chloride cotransport in cell volume and osmotic stress
rationale: Members cover Na-K-Cl cotransporters, renal sodium and chloride transport, and cellular responses to osmotic and salt stress; Ca-activated K channels, SLC26A3 and paracellular transport distinguish it from Na/H exchanger, P-type ATPase and K2P channel confusables.

qualifier: transcriptional regulation and terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid differentiation and its transcriptional regulation
rationale: Nearly all members describe erythroid commitment and terminal red cell differentiation (one module is TAK1/ATF stress signalling, an outlier); the erythroid focus separates it from megakaryocyte and haematopoietic stem cell confusables.

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis and STRA6 defects
name: Vitamin A metabolism to retinoic acid, with STRA6 defects
rationale: Members are retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport; retinoic acid biosynthesis distinguishes it from visual-cycle confusables and retinoid disease events (STRA6) from vitamin D/retinoic acid response confusables.

qualifier: metanephric nephron segmentation and nephric duct
name: Metanephric nephron patterning, tubule segmentation and nephric duct development
rationale: Members describe nephric duct formation and metanephric nephron patterning and tubule segment development; confusables centre on ureteric bud formation, organ induction and kidney size.

qualifier: snRNP and box C/D snoRNP assembly
name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP assembly
rationale: Members are methylation of rRNA, tRNA and snRNA with snoRNP/snRNP biogenesis and Cajal body localization; snRNP assembly, snRNA transport and cap hypermethylation distinguish it from pseudouridylation and diphthamide confusables.

qualifier: capping and suppression of recombination and NHEJ
name: Telomere end protection and capping against recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and protection from recombination and end joining; confusables instead carry C-strand replication, D-loop/t-circle processing or telomerase extension.

qualifier: TGFBR3 co-receptor and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants
name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling, TGFBR3 and cancer mutants
rationale: Members span TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH signalling through SMADs and RUNX3 targets; cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs plus TGFBR3 regulation distinguish it from RUNX3-only, ligand-sequestration and BMP-module confusables.
